clauses.quote: The Referred Participating Teacher may attach a written response to the Consulting Teacher's Report
The Referred Participating Teacher may request a meeting with the Peer Review Panel to discuss the Report within 20 duty days.
The Referred Participating Teacher has the right to an Association representative of his or her choice at this meeting.
A copy of the Consulting Teacher's Report shall be submitted to, and discussed with, the Referred Participating Teacher to receive his or her signature before it is submitted to the Panel.
clauses.subject_text: A copy of the Consulting Teacher's Report

clauses.quote: The Final Report of the Referred Participating Teacher's participation in the PAR Program shall be made available for placement in his or her personnel file
clauses.subject_text: The Final Report of the Referred Participating Teacher's participation in the PAR Program

clauses.quote: The Final Report of the Referred Participating Teacher's participation in the PAR Program may be used as part of the evaluation of the Referred Participating Teacher conducted during participation in the program.
clauses.subject_text: The Final Report of the Referred Participating Teacher's participation in the PAR Program

clauses.quote: Consulting Teachers shall be provided reasonable release time for performing duties which require them to visit classroom and/or for inservice training.
If inservice training takes place outside of work hours, these teachers shall be paid their daily or prorated per diem rate of pay.
The designated evaluator shall retain the responsibility for the evaluation.
The Peer Review Panel shall develop and recommend a budget to the Governing Board through the Superintendent or through the regular budget development process.
